title: M5Unified #445: build arduino-esp32 3.3.13 / 4.0.0 in Arduino CI (build-level verification)

execution.environment: GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest with arduino-cli 1.1.1 (upstream PR run 44725789948; author fork run 44696180242); macOS arm64 host used only for read-only evidence collection; no local rebuild

checks.detail: 1 file, +35/-7 in .github/workflows/ArduinoBuild.yml; matrix 15 -> 21 rows: four rows renamed 3.3.12 -> 3.3.13, one 3.3.13 P4 ChipVariant=postv3 row and five 4.0.0 rows added; no removed jobs, no duplicate (board, version, variant) pairs; patch applies to base 6df0152 and reproduces the head workflow byte-for-byte

upstream Arduino Build run 44725789948 on head 3d7abeed: 21/21 jobs success (whole run ~6 min); all 10 new/renamed rows success in 69-115 s each, and each job log shows the intended platform (3.3.13 or 4.0.0) with 0 'error:' and 0 'warning:' lines; author fork run 44696180242 on the same head is also 21/21 success
37/37 checks pass on the PR (Arduino Build 21, ESP-IDF Build 14, SourceCheck 1, Forward events 1); mergeable=MERGEABLE, mergeStateStatus=CLEAN; ESP-IDF Build was untouched by this PR
Espressif board-manager index lists 4.0.0 newest and 3.3.13 next; release notes say 4.0.0 is based on ESP-IDF v6.1.1 (published 2026-11-19) and 3.3.13 on v5.5.6+ (2026-11-17), matching the PR body

boards.txt on 3.3.13 defaults esp32p4.build.chip_variant=esp32p4_es (pre-v3), on 4.0.0 defaults to esp32p4 (v3+); both tags define menu.ChipVariant.prev3/postv3; platform.txt selects the prebuilt SDK via {build.chip_variant}; the CI sketch sizes differ per variant (3.3.13: 538300 default vs 539696 postv3; 4.0.0: 531556 default vs 534536 prev3), so each release is genuinely built for both revisions

M5GFX CI on develop covers 2.0.17 / 3.1.3 / 3.3.0 (C5) / M5Stack 2.1.4 and never builds M5Unified; M5Unified CI covers 3.0.7 / 3.2.1 / 3.3.13 / M5Stack and clones M5GFX at the PR base branch (master else develop), so the new comment's description matches reality

m5stack/M5GFX#437 (OPEN) adds the identical 3.3.13 / 4.0.0 row set including both P4 ChipVariant rows, so the pair is consistent; the 'built by both CIs' wording only becomes fully true once both PRs land

CI compiles examples/Test/build_test (includes <M5Unified.h>, calls Display/Speaker/Mic/Imu/Touch/Btn APIs) to a BIN only; no flash, boot, peripheral or network behavior is exercised, so runtime correctness on arduino-esp32 4.0.0 remains outside this PR's claim

not run locally: arduino-cli and the 3.3.13 / 4.0.0 platform packages are not installed on this host; the object under test is the YAML matrix itself, which the PR's own CI executed, so a hand-run arduino-cli build would not exercise the YAML change
not applicable: the change only extends a GitHub Actions matrix and does not change runtime behavior
structurally not applicable: a CI matrix change produces no firmware behavior difference, so no virtual device model can observe anything; the only observable is build success
booting on ESP32-P4 silicon of either revision (pre-v3 / v3+) was not exercised; the PR claims only that both targets compile
the 4.0.0 rows cover esp32 / s3 / c5 / p4 only; C3 / C6 / H2 are still not built at 4.0 (same shape as the 3.3 rows), so SoC-specific 4.0 regressions on those parts would not be caught
